evals.name: smiles-to-unifac-groups
evals.prompt: I have the SMILES CC(Cc1ccc(cc1)C(C(=O)O)C)C for ibuprofen. Decompose it into UNIFAC groups with GCIdentifier and tell me the group counts.
evals.expected_output: Uses get_groups_from_smiles with UNIFACGroups; returns COOH=>1, CH3=>3, CH=>1, ACH=>4, ACCH2=>1, ACCH=>1.

evals.name: find-missing-saft-gamma-mie-group
evals.prompt: get_groups_from_smiles throws 'Could not find all groups' when I fragment CCC(=O)CC (2-pentanone) with SAFTgammaMieGroups. What group is missing and how do I get GCIdentifier to propose it? Show me the reduced recommendation.
evals.expected_output: Explains SAFT-gamma-Mie lacks a ketone group; uses find_missing_groups_from_smiles with reduced=true; recommends GCPair for C=O= ( [CX3;H0;!R](=[OX1;H0;!R]) ).

evals.name: clapeyron-unifac-bridge
evals.prompt: Build a Clapeyron UNIFAC model for a water + ibuprofen mixture. I only know the molecule name 'ibuprofen', not its SMILES. Use GCIdentifier to get the groups and wire it into Clapeyron, then show computing the activity coefficient.
evals.expected_output: Uses get_groups_from_name with ChemicalIdentifiers loaded; passes (component, groups) tuple into UNIFAC(["water", (component, groups)]); calls activity_coefficient.
